About these listings

  • Standing rule: only events with a named act are listed. Rows such as “live music, no act named,” unnamed dueling pianos, karaoke, DJ nights with no live band, and brunches with an unnamed pianist are left out. Venues whose only listings were like that do not appear on the page. Exception (Nov 23, 2026): every in-range Fresh Fridays event is listed, with “Band TBD” until the act is announced.
  • Range: every Thursday–Sunday from Thu, Dec 3, 2026 through Sun, Feb 28, 2027, which is 13 weekends. Only venues with at least one listing appear in the tabs above.
  • Sources, in order of preference: the venue’s own site or calendar (including calendar widgets that pull the venue’s posted events), then ticketing pages, then third-party listings. Rows tagged (GoTonight) come from GoTonight.com band and venue posts. Where the venue’s own calendar and a third-party listing disagree, the venue wins.
  • Facebook was checked read-only on Nov 21 for the nine venues that mainly post there. Only explicitly dated Thursday–Sunday music events were added; they are tagged (Facebook). Other venues’ Facebook pages were not checked, and the Facebook pages have not been rechecked since Nov 21, so late-January and February Facebook events are not yet included.
  • Fresh Fridays (downtown Sarasota’s free first-Friday series) moves each month, so its copy-address and calendar entry use that event’s own location.
  • Wellen Park’s daily generic “Live Music” series is not listed (no acts named).
  • Standing weekly schedules with no dated listings (for example “live music Fri & Sat”) are not expanded into rows. Recurring entries appear only where a calendar lists the specific date.
  • Many venues post only a few weeks ahead, so later weekends, especially January and February, are thinner and will fill in. Check back closer to the date.
  • Calendar entries: a start time with no end time gets a 3-hour slot; “close” gets a 2-hour slot; rows without a time are all-day entries.
